title: monster@6
description: monster@6 = monster@5 carried in full plus optional presentation visual (kind, bin, art_root, size_short). monster@5 -> monster@6 is an identity migration: the body is unchanged and visual stays absent. visual is presentation only and is not part of Combat::hash, log_hash, or content hashes. Integers only (4.3). size_short is not applied in M0. Huge and gargantuan have no stand-in art bin in M0.

rating.description: String so fractional CRs need no floats.

legendary_actions.description: Descriptive and ignored by the engine (T&C-G11 is deferred); common@1 action list type, never loaded.

presentation.description: Presentation-only; 'ai' not allowed in v2 (use behavior.ai).

traits.description: Traits. Effects are mechanically active; never bake their numbers into actions or other stats.

forward_compat.description: Opt-in flags for engine features that are not implemented yet (elevation, T&C-G12). Descriptive and ignored by sim; listed with the inert mechanics. New enum values widen the @4 schemas additively.

inert_mechanics.description: Mechanics the document carries but the engine must ignore (e.g. 'reactions', 'bonus_actions', 'equipment', 'damage[1..]'). Written by the 3->4 migration; a hand-written @4 file may carry it too.

no_breath.description: R-G11 creature fact (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6), default false: the monster doesn't need to breathe (Stinking Cloud's automatic success with auto_success_no_breath); maps to Combatant::no_breath. Reserved: the sim archetype loader (engine/core/sim/src/content.cpp, Engine Core) does not read it yet, so the validator warns and it has no effect until then.

shapechanger.description: R-G11 creature fact (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6), default false: the monster is a shapechanger (Moonbeam's shapechanger_disadvantage); maps to Combatant::shapechanger. Reserved: the sim archetype loader (engine/core/sim/src/content.cpp, Engine Core) does not read it yet, so the validator warns and it has no effect until then.

evil.description: R-G11 creature fact (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 4.6), default false: the monster is evil for zone rows (Spirit Guardians' evil_damage_type); maps to Combatant::evil. Reserved: the sim archetype loader (engine/core/sim/src/content.cpp, Engine Core) does not read it yet, so the validator warns and it has no effect until then.

derive.description: Default false: printed AC / to-hit / damage are used as written. true: they are derived and asserted (EQUIPMENT 5.6).

equipment.description: {item, equipped?, count?} references to item@2 documents.

ac_adjust.description: Added to the derived AC (step 4 of EQUIPMENT 1.2); needs a reason.

weapons.description: Monster-local weapons (EQUIPMENT 5.4): the item@2 weapon fields, weapon_class optional.

hands.description: Explicit hand slots; default 2 when the monster holds a weapon or shield, else 0.

passive_perception_reason.description: Tier-A (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 25): senses.passive_perception is the SRD printed value and differs from 10 + Perception; the printed value wins in the sim (Combatant::passive_perception_override). Without it a mismatch is a validator error.

stat_block.description: common@2 stat_block (copied; common@2 unchanged) with actions[] items monster@5 action and proficiency_bonus optional.

visual.description: Presentation only (Engine Core M0). Never read by rules and never folded into Combat::hash, log_hash, or chunk content_hash. Absent: a humanoid type resolves to paperdoll; any other type resolves to a stand-in bin from size (tiny, small, medium, large). Huge and gargantuan have no art bin in M0. size_short is stored and not applied (M1: torso+head _short plates, else scale about the feet pivot).

kit.description: Kit id Render & Platform loads. Wins over presentation.sprite. Absent: presentation.sprite, else paperdoll or standin.<standin_bin>.

standin_bin.description: Stand-in canvas. Ignored for paperdoll. Huge and gargantuan are not M0 bins.

art_root.description: Pack-relative kit directory. The loader checks that it exists when the pack directory is known. '..' is refused.

size_short.description: Reserved. M0 does not swap _short plates and does not scale. M1.

range.description: [normal, long] range in feet (SRD range 80/320 = [80, 320]); targets beyond normal and up to long range are attacked with disadvantage.

damage.description: BASE damage: weapon die + ability modifier (+ magic bonus). Never fold feature bonuses (e.g. Dueling +2) in; feature effects such as damage_bonus are applied by the engine. monster@5: a component may be {flat, type} instead of {dice, type} (SRD 'Hit: 1 piercing damage'; CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 19).

qualifiers.description: monster@3 / character@3: what the weapon is made of / counts as, for qualified resistances (nonmagical, silvered, adamantine). Inert in earlier versions.

attack.description: attack_effect (sim #170): the attack roll's mode; default ranged.

half_hp_damage.description: Swarm (sim #172): weapon attacks only; replaces the dice of damage[0] while the attacker has half its hit points or fewer (SRD swarm bites: 2d6, or 1d6 at half HP or fewer). Needs at least one die.

long_range_ft.description: attack_effect (sim #174): ranged only; long range in feet, greater than range_ft. Legal out to long_range_ft, at disadvantage beyond range_ft (giant spider Web 30/60).

zero_hp.description: save_effect / save_condition (sim #174): when the damage drops the target to 0 hit points it is stable and gains condition for duration.n rounds (600 = 1 hour, outlasts healing) and while for as long as that lasts (giant spider bite: poisoned 600 rounds, paralyzed while poisoned). Needs damage; condition and while must differ.

control.description: VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2y: save_effect only (class feature save actions: Turn Undead, Turn the Unholy). command is spell-only (load error).

control_excludes_creature_types.description: 7.2y: save_effect with control only; creature types the control has no effect on.

destroy_undead_max_cr8.description: 7.2y: save_effect with control turned only (Destroy Undead).

target_creature_types.description: 7.2y: save_effect only; only creatures of these types are targeted (others make no save and take nothing): Turn Undead [undead], Turn the Unholy [fiend, undead].

duration.description: 7.2y: save_effect with control only; the control lasts n rounds (Turn Undead: 1 minute = 10).

weapon.description: The wielded weapon: an item@2 content id (listed in equipment[]) or '#<id>' of a weapons[] entry (EQUIPMENT 5.3 / 5.4).

flat.description: CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 19: a fixed amount printed without dice (SRD 'Hit: 1 slashing damage'). The whole amount: no ability term, so damage_ability is not allowed. Must equal the action's flat damage[0].

damage_ability.description: Default: ability. 'none' for blocks that print no modifier.

natural.description: Natural or monster-local weapon source: exactly one of dice (NdM) or flat (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 19).

attack_bonus.description: Overrides the derived total to-hit (not a delta); needs a reason (EQUIPMENT 5.5).

damage_override.description: Overrides the derived damage[0] dice (not a delta) when the printed stat block can't be derived; needs a reason citing the SRD 5.1 stat block (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS 21). SRD Gladiator thrown Spear: 2d6 + 4.

use.description: How the `weapon` is used for this action (EQUIPMENT 2.1 WeaponUse): two_hands = versatile die or a two-handed melee weapon, thrown = a thrown use of a melee weapon. Explicit, never inferred from the action id.

drain.description: Batch 3 (Lich ruling; sim content.cpp, rules5e life_drain): weapon attacks only. SRD 5.1 Life Drain: the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken (after a Constitution save vs save.dc when present; success: no reduction); the reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest, and a maximum of 0 kills it. Wight: {max_hp true, save {ability con, dc 13}}.

damage_type.description: Batch 3 (vampire spawn): only the damage of this type taken counts (after immunity / resistance / vulnerability); must be one of the action's damage[] types.

heal_self.description: Batch 3 (vampire spawn): the attacker regains hit points equal to the reduction.

curse.description: Batch 3 (mummy Rotting Fist): on a hit, a Con save; on a failure the target can't regain hit points (no_regain_hp). Weapon attacks only.

ability.description: CONTENT_CONVENTIONS "Attack ability": the ability the attack's to_hit and damage use (none: no ability modifier). Optional; absent = inferred from to_hit (Str on a Str/Dex tie, with a loader warning); a finesse weapon without it uses the better of Str / Dex. Read when a score is reduced (Strength Drain) and by the two-weapon off-hand. Weapon attacks only.

ability_drain.description: Batch 3 (shadow Strength Drain): on a hit, after the damage, the target's Strength score is reduced by the dice; it dies if this reduces its Strength to 0; a short or long rest restores it. Weapon attacks only.

target_requires_any.description: Batch 3 (vampire spawn Bite: "one willing creature, or a creature that is grappled by the vampire, incapacitated, or restrained"): the target must meet at least one. willing counts only for an ally with ActionRequest target_willing. On a weapon attack, any of the four gates. On a monster@5 save_effect, only grappled_by_self (Chuul Tentacles, Otyugh Tentacle Slam): each named target must be grappled by the user, and the cast is refused before the action is spent. targets (1..8, default 1) on that save is how many creatures one cast may name. No area. Chuul Tentacles also sets rider_only, so the save is the Multiattack free rider and not its own action.

rider_only.description: B3b (monster@5 save_effect only): this save is not a standalone action. A multiattack option's free_rider names it. After that option's attacks, it may be used once this turn without spending an action, on one target that passes target_requires_any. A cast outside that window is refused and does not spend the action.

feet.description: Batch 3 teleport action (blink dog 40): up to this many feet to an unoccupied space the creature can see.

jump_ft.description: B8 Deadly Leap: the jump, in feet, that must already have been taken this turn. A multiple of 5.

save_alt.description: B8 Deadly Leap: the other ability of the target's choice. save.ability is the one used on a tie.

push_ft.description: B8 Deadly Leap: feet a successful save pushes the creature out of the leaper's space.

fling_ft.description: B10 Whirlwind: up to this many feet the failed save flings the creature, in a random direction.

impact.description: B10 Whirlwind: damage for every per_ft feet a thrown creature actually moved before it struck an object, and the same packet a creature it is thrown at takes on a failed impact_save. One of dice or flat.

impact_save.description: B10 Whirlwind: the save a creature the target is thrown at makes. A failure takes the impact packet and is knocked prone. A success takes neither.

grapple.description: B11 Whelm: a failed save grapples a creature of this size or smaller (escape DC). The target is restrained until that grapple ends. One Large, or up to two Medium or smaller.

crush.description: B11 Whelm: damage each grappled target takes at the start of each of the user's later turns. One of dice or flat.

with_attack.description: Batch 3 teleport action: one attack (an attack action id) made after the teleport without another action (SRD 5.1 blink dog: 'Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.'; teleport-then-bite only).

also_on_fail_by.description: Tier-A §26 (save_effect only; SRD 5.1 mummy Dreadful Glare 'If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration.'): failing the save by margin or more also applies condition on the same effect entry (same duration; ending it ends both), even if the target is immune to the primary condition. Needs a tracked primary condition in apply[] and differs from it; no escalates / control / area.

immune_on_success.description: Tier-A §26 (save_effect only): a success makes the target immune to this action for hours. same_action = from every creature using this archetype's action (SRD 'the dreadful glare of all mummies'); same_source = from this creature only. SIM_EVENTS 0xE1.

target_must_see_source.description: Tier-A §26 (save_effect only; 'One creature ... that can see the mummy'): a target that cannot see the user (blinded, or the sight hook says so) makes no save and gains no immunity (FeatureTriggered c = 3).

escalates.description: B4 (monster@5 save_effect, including an area): a failed save applies the primary apply[] condition; a failed repeat save replaces it with escalate_to. Same SpellDef fields as gaze (basilisk / medusa). SRD 5.1 Gorgon Petrifying Breath. ActiveSpellEffect::escalates is already hashed; no new tag.

escalate_to.description: B4: the condition a failed repeat save, or a first save failed by escalate_margin or more, replaces the primary with. Omitted means petrified.

escalate_margin.description: B4: failing the first save by this much or more applies escalate_to at once, with no repeat save (medusa gaze is 5). 0 never does (gorgon).

allOf.description: Monster area action (AOE_MONSTER_ABILITIES PR2): one shape, one save, one synthetic SpellDef on the spell area path. Cone, line, cube, sphere, or cylinder (height is stored and still ignored). on_success half is half damage. Recharge and per-day uses are the existing usage object.
sim #170 compile_attack_effect: an attack roll that only applies conditions (giant spider Web); every apply[] entry has a Strength escape.
B4: escalates / escalate_to / escalate_margin are save_effect only (an area is allowed). Gaze keeps its own keys on the trait.
VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2y: the control / target_creature_types keys are save_effect only.
Batch 3: feet / with_attack are teleport-action keys; a teleport action needs feet.

B5 Reel: pull each named creature grappled by the user up to feet straight toward the user. Not a save. Omitting forced_feet pulls the full distance; a shorter multiple of 5 is ActionRequest::forced_feet (0xB4).

B8 Deadly Leap: its own action. A jump of jump_ft this turn, then each creature in the leaper's space saves. Fail: both damage components and prone. Success: half of each and a push of push_ft, or prone in the space if that push cannot move. save.ability wins a tie against save_alt.

B10 Whirlwind: each creature in the user's space makes the save. Failure: the one damage component, prone, and a fling of up to fling_ft. Success: half that damage, no fling, no prone. A strike deals impact once per per_ft feet moved. A creature in the way makes impact_save; that success takes nothing. usage recharge is required.

B11 Whelm: each creature in the user's space makes the save. Failure: the one damage component, and a restraining grapple when the target is within grapple.max_size and the cap has room. Success: no damage, pushed out of the space. crush is the later turn-start damage. usage recharge is required. on_success is not a key.

weapon_extra_dice_effect.description: monster@5-local trait kind (EQUIPMENT 5.3, Rules #247 brute_dice; common@2 unchanged): a weapon deals `dice` extra dice of its own damage die. Read only by the derivation (derive: true). SRD Bugbear Brute: {kind weapon_extra_dice, dice 1, melee_only true}.

melee_only.description: Melee uses only; a thrown use is ranged and gets no extra dice.

save_advantage_effect.description: monster@5-local trait kind (batch 3, field_shapes_proposal Gap 2; common@2 unchanged): advantage (or disadvantage) on saving throws matching every listed gate; a gate list matches when the effect imposes one of save_vs_conditions or deals one of vs_damage_types (either set). At least one gate is required. SRD Magic Resistance: {kind save_advantage, magical true}. Dark Devotion: {save_vs_conditions [charmed, frightened]}.

magical.description: true: only saves against spells and other magical effects.

aura_effect.description: monster@5-local trait kind (batch 3, ghast Stench; common@2 unchanged): a creature-sourced aura that exists from the start of combat and works while the creature is alive (incapacitated or unconscious included); it ends when the creature dies. Each creature that starts its turn within radius_ft of it makes the save; on a failure it has the condition until the start of its next turn. On a success with success_immunity_hours, that creature is immune to this creature's aura for that many hours. SRD Stench (ghast): {radius_ft 5, on start_turn, save {con, 10}, condition poisoned, duration until_start_of_next_turn, success_immunity_hours 24}.

keen_senses_effect.description: monster@5-local trait kind (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §30; common@2 unchanged): advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on a listed sense. SRD Keen Hearing and Smell: {kind keen_senses, senses [hearing, smell]}. Does not change the printed passive Perception.

regen_effect.description: monster@5-local trait kind (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §31; common@2 unchanged): regains `amount` hit points at the start of its turn unless it took a `suppressed_by` damage type since its last turn started. At 0 hit points it is not dead until a later turn starts without regenerating (SRD troll). SRD Troll: {kind regen, amount 10, suppressed_by [acid, fire]}. Not oni, shield guardian, or vampire spawn.

amount.description: Hit points regained (int16). Capped at the creature's hit point maximum.

suppressed_by.description: Damage types that suppress the next start-of-turn regeneration. A type reduced to 0 by resistance or immunity does not count.

freeze_effect.description: monster@5-local trait kind (CONTENT_CONVENTIONS §42; common@2 unchanged): if the creature takes a listed damage type, every speed is reduced by speed_sub feet until the end of its next turn. SRD Water Elemental Freeze: {kind freeze, by [cold], speed_sub 20}. One reduction; a later hit refreshes it.

by.description: Damage types that apply the slow. A type reduced to 0 by resistance or immunity does not count (DamageApplied::types_dealt).

speed_sub.description: Feet subtracted from every speed after speed_scale 1/1 (rules5e ModifierSpec::speed_sub).

monster_damage.description: monster@5-local action damage component (common@2 $defs/damage unchanged): either common@2 damage ({dice, type, bonus_vs?}) or flat damage {flat, type}. Exactly one of dice / flat (oneOf). flat maps to rules5e::DiceExpr{0, 0, flat}: no dice are rolled (no rng), and a critical hit does not double it (SRD 5.1). The ability modifier stays in the dice string ('1d6+2'); flat is not a modifier and takes none.
